_comment: 関係節レベルの情景絵(第2弾・9組18枚)。対の2枚は「誰がその状態か」だけが違う。絵の手がかり(涙・頭を下げる・水しぶき・傘の有無・なでる 等)を各組1つ持たせる。画像を images/scene/<id>.png に生成・最適化したあと `node scripts/merge-pending.mjs` で取り込む。
prompt_template: {english_prompt}, simple scene illustration on a pure white background, flat illustration style. Style: clean, educational illustration for speech therapy materials; two characters, both clearly recognizable, and it must be obvious at a glance which one is in the described state. Keep the same character designs across the paired pictures. Colors: soft, natural. Composition: only the characters and the objects needed for the scene, at most a thin ground line, no other background, no text, no speech bubbles, no logos. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
